overview.title: Where Safi's reputation is shaped
overview.p1: The potters' quarter gathers traditional kilns and workshops. This is where the know-how that made Safi's name lives on.
overview.p2: You can watch clay being worked, firing, and sometimes buy directly from artisans.
overview.p3: Combine with the National Ceramics Museum.
